name: mobile-mode
description: Phone-driven sessions end each turn with tappable AskUserQuestion options and a push notification, injected per-turn and scoped to the session you toggle it in.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Local hours with no routine pushes, as START-END in 24h (e.g. 23-7), or off. Approval requests and failures still push.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.description: Buttons under the latest reply in the Claude mobile app, as Label=prompt pairs separated by |. Empty hides them.
quickActions.default: Continue=Continue.|Simpler=Explain that more simply, in a few short lines.|Next?=What should we do next? Give me 2-4 options.

longTurnMinutes.title: Long-turn push (minutes)
longTurnMinutes.description: Send one 'still working' push when a phone-driven turn runs this long. 0 turns it off.

suggestions.title: Next-prompt suggestions
suggestions.description: After a turn, a small model proposes 2-3 next prompts: shown as buttons under the reply in the Claude mobile app (phone), also as the prompt box's Tab suggestion in the terminal (always), or off.

suggestModel.title: Suggestion model
suggestModel.description: Model for next-prompt suggestions (alias like haiku, or a full id).
